name: Diva's Door
description: A loud aria in a soaring tenor issues from the door, sending soundwaves outward.
disable: DC 38 Performance check (legendary) to cancel out the aria's soundwaves with another, DC 43 Thievery check (master) to pick apart the arcane energies, or Dispel Magic (9th rank, counteract DC 36) to counteract the trap

offensiveAbilities.name: Resounding Aria
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the warehouse's double door without uttering the password

Effect All creatures within area C2 take 6d12+37 sonic damage (DC 38 basic Fortitude save); a creature that critically fails is permanently Deafened.
